title: ax-commons SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for commons/skills/<domain>/<name>/SKILL.md. Follows the open Agent Skills frontmatter so ChatGPT and Claude load it unchanged; project fields sit under metadata as string-to-string pairs.

name.description: Lowercase-hyphen name, equal to the skill directory name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it.

purpose.description: What task the skill addresses and for whom.

reference_sources.description: Where the procedure or facts come from, separated by '; '.

reviewer.description: The domain reviewer responsible for the content.

version.description: Semantic version, bumped on every change.

sunset.description: How the skill retires: removed entirely, narrowed in scope, or narrowed in purpose.

issue_report_path.description: Where users report problems with this skill.

languages.description: Comma-separated content languages; the body must carry each listed language.

body.log_task: The body must end with a log_task step for when the ax-commons MCP server is available, and must state that the skill works as plain instructions without it.
